title: Heartbreak feels good at a show like this. Had a blast seeing @a kidm...
transcript: After seeing a rehearsal of A Kidman Carol last week, I got to actually see a preview performance today. One still hilarious. I always wonder when I go see a comedy more than once if it's still going to make me laugh the second time, and it absolutely did. I also loved getting to see the full production with the costumes and the video elements, because there were visual gags that I just wasn't getting at the first time that I now thought were hilarious. Especially the costume design in this. So incredibly well done. A Kidman Carol is a new Christmas Carol parody written by Kevin Zak, who also wrote Ginger Twinsies, that takes place on the Eve of Oscar night, when Cate Blanchett is visited by the spirit of three Nicole Kidmans. And so there's a lot of movie humour, definitely, but there's also just a lot of chronically online humour. Like, I feel like as somebody who scrolls TikTok on the regular, there were a lot of jokes that were geared directly to me. And of course, humour is very, very subjective, so if this is not your style of comedy, then it may not be for you. I thought it was hilarious. I did not see ginger twinsies, and now I'm kind of sad that I didn't. But the comedy does feel very much in line with, like, a Titanique or a big gay jamboree, both written by Marla Mindelle, who is in this as Nicole Kidman so feels very much in that same family of humour styles. And I think, like Titanique, a Kidman Carol is one that I find instantly quotable. I was already quoting it with my friend who went to the rehearsal with me last week, and so there's just. There's so many gems in this. This is absolutely still in preview. So while unlike in the rehearsal, we now have sets and costumes, and that was fantastic to see, you can still see that they're still working out some of the kinks in terms of the timing, especially all the transitions. Because when you put costumes into the show and all of a sudden you have to do quick changes, that slows down some of the, the transitions between moments. And so as they get through the preview period, the timing will definitely tighten. And a tighter comedic timing leads to more jokes and the humour landing better. But already I was laughing a ton in this. Now, as far as tickets go, I was invited to go see this, but tickets are very affordable. Uh, tickets full price are up down to $45 on todaytix right now. So you can get pretty cheap tickets for this through the run through December 30th.
